extraction.Name: Samuel Cottier
extraction.Refused/Protested: did not want his patent in fee but took it because he was told that if he did not take it and pay the taxes that he would lose the land
extraction.Sold/Mortgaged: sold his land to Dick Lessert for $1850.00, rather than to lose it for taxes
extraction.Tax burden forced sale/Mortgage: could not pay the taxes so he sold his land to Dick Lessert for $1850.00, rather than to lose it for taxes
extraction.Occupation/Income: makes his living by common labor
extraction.NOTES: mentally competent, in fair health; has nothing no one depending on him for support; has received no aid from the Government, State or County since he was granted a patent in fee; has nothing whatever, no land no home or anything; document sworn November 28, 1928; County of Shannon, State of South Dakota
